purpose: Tools installed INSIDE the Python Eye Ubuntu (PRoot) container. apt packages come from Ubuntu's signed archive; Node.js from nodejs.org with SHASUMS256 verification; npm/pip packages from their official registries.

command_rules.install: bash -lc: 'set -e' + apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends <apt> + <script> + python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages --no-cache-dir <pip> + npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit <npm>
command_rules.probe: bash -lc <probe>; Ready only when exit code is 0 AND the output matches the 'expect' regular expression
command_rules.remove: apt-get remove -y <apt> / python3 -m pip uninstall -y --break-system-packages <pip> / npm uninstall -g <npm> / <remove>

packages.name: Core CLI utilities
packages.description: curl, wget, jq, tree, zip/unzip, nano, xz and CA certificates — needed by most other tools.

packages.name: Python 3 + pip + venv
packages.description: Ubuntu's full CPython 3 with pip, venv and headers, for scripts, data work and Python backends (separate from the IDE's built-in Python 3.10 engine).

packages.name: uv (fast Python package manager)
packages.description: Astral's uv: Rust-based pip/venv replacement, 10-100x faster resolving and installing.

packages.name: Node.js LTS + npm
packages.description: Official Node.js 24 LTS for linux-arm64 from nodejs.org (SHA-256 checked against SHASUMS256.txt) with npm and npx.
packages.script:
set -e
DIR=latest-v24.x
SUMS=$(curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/$DIR/SHASUMS256.txt)
F=$(printf '%s\n' "$SUMS" | grep -o 'node-v[0-9.]*-linux-arm64\.tar\.xz' | head -n1)
test -n "$F"
cd /tmp
curl -fsSLO "https://nodejs.org/dist/$DIR/$F"
printf '%s\n' "$SUMS" | grep "  $F\$" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xJf "$F" -C /usr/local --strip-components=1 --no-same-owner
rm -f "$F"

packages.name: TypeScript compiler
packages.description: tsc — the official TypeScript compiler (npm).

packages.name: Bun (fast JS/TS runtime)
packages.description: Bun runtime, bundler and package manager (linux-arm64 build via npm).

packages.name: C/C++ Build Tools (GCC, make, gdb)
packages.description: build-essential: gcc, g++, make, libc headers and gdb. Probe compiles and runs a real C program.

packages.name: Clang / LLVM + clangd
packages.description: Clang C/C++ compiler, LLD linker and the clangd language server.

packages.name: CMake + Ninja
packages.description: CMake meta-build system and the Ninja build tool.

packages.name: Go
packages.description: Go compiler and tools. Probe builds and runs a real Go program.
packages.probe:
mkdir -p /tmp/pyeye-go && cd /tmp/pyeye-go && printf 'package main
import "fmt"
func main(){fmt.Println("pyeye-go-ok")}
' > main.go && go run main.go && go version

packages.name: gopls (Go language server)
packages.description: Official Go language server for completion, diagnostics and navigation.

packages.name: Rust + Cargo
packages.description: rustc compiler and the Cargo package manager from Ubuntu.

packages.name: PHP + Composer
packages.description: PHP CLI and the Composer dependency manager for classic sites and Laravel projects.

packages.name: OpenJDK 21 (Ubuntu)
packages.description: Headless OpenJDK 21 JDK inside the container (the IDE's own Android JDK tools are separate).

packages.name: Ruby
packages.description: Ruby interpreter with gem and development headers.

packages.name: Claude Code CLI (claude)

packages.name: Gemini CLI (gemini)
packages.description: Google's open-source AI agent for the terminal. Needs your own Google account or API key.

packages.name: OpenAI Codex CLI (codex)
packages.description: OpenAI's coding agent for the terminal. Needs your own OpenAI account or API key.

packages.name: Git + Git LFS
packages.description: Distributed version control, plus Large File Storage for big assets.

packages.name: GitHub CLI (gh)
packages.description: Pull requests, issues, releases and repositories from the terminal.

packages.description: Super-fast recursive text search.

packages.name: YAML language server

packages.name: Flutter & Dart SDK (stable)
packages.description: Flutter stable channel and Dart for linux-arm64 (CLI, web and Linux targets). Large download. Android APK builds additionally need Android SDK tools that run on ARM64.
packages.script:
set -e
if [ ! -d /opt/flutter/.git ]; then git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git /opt/flutter; fi
git config --global --add safe.directory /opt/flutter
ln -sf /opt/flutter/bin/flutter /usr/local/bin/flutter
ln -sf /opt/flutter/bin/dart /usr/local/bin/dart
flutter --disable-analytics >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
flutter --version
